jcr:root.jcr:description: Dashboard three-column layout. Column 1 starts under the My Spend tab; column 1 ends at the 'r' of Cards in Virtual Cards; column 2 starts after that 'r'; column 3 matches the header's right content edge. Supports optional ARIA landmark role + label (dialog Accessibility tab) for keyboard / screen-reader navigation.
jcr:root.jcr:title: VSC Three Column Grid
